D: A sheltered Louisiana waterboy discovers he can tackle like nobody else and becomes a college football star.
P: Serve the drinks when Bobby hands out the water.
S: Bayou hush puppies with Cajun remoulade
Spicy Cajun mayo dip. Captain Insano shows no mercy.

Golden cornmeal hush puppies with spring onion and a pinch of cayenne, fried crisp and served with a tangy Cajun remoulade for dipping. Mix 200g fine cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp cayenne. Whisk in 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk, then fold in 3 sliced spring onions. Rest 10 minutes. Drop heaped teaspoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain on paper towel. For the remoulade, mix 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp Cajun seasoning and a squeeze of lemon.
Cajun spiced prawns swirled in garlic butter, with baguette

Green prawns seared hot and fast in garlic and Cajun spiced butter, finished with lemon and parsley and served with crusty bread to mop the pan. Peel and devein 800g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 2 tsp Cajun seasoning. Heat a large frying pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil. Add the prawns in one layer and cook 90 seconds a side. Drop the heat, add 60g butter and 3 crushed garlic cloves and swirl for 1 minute until foaming. Squeeze over 1 lemon and scatter with chopped parsley. Serve straight from the pan with a sliced baguette.
M: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo
Mama's right! Dark roux gumbo, chicken, smoked sausage, okra, rice.

A dark roux gumbo of chicken thigh, smoked sausage, okra and the holy trinity, ladled over steamed rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Stir 80g plain flour into 80ml oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until it turns dark brown like chocolate. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Add 600g diced chicken thigh, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 1.2L chicken stock, and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g sliced okra for 10 minutes. Serve over 300g steamed long grain rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.
Vicki Vallencourt's blackened catfish po' boys
Vicki's just out of jail, she knows a good sandwich

Catfish fillets rubbed with Cajun spice and blackened in a hot pan, in soft rolls with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickles and remoulade. Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the remoulade. Coat the fish in the Cajun seasoning. Melt the butter in a very hot pan and cook the fish until blackened and just cooked. Split the rolls, spread with remoulade and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles and fish.
W: Creamy brown sugar pecan pralines spooned out to set

Creamy, fudgy New Orleans pecan pralines made with brown sugar, butter and toasted pecans, set into rounds that snap then melt in the mouth. Toast 200g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes. In a heavy saucepan, combine 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml thickened cream and 40g butter. Stir over medium heat until it boils, then cook without stirring until it reaches 115C on a sugar thermometer, about 8 minutes. Take off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and the pecans and beat with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes until it thickens and turns cloudy. Quickly spoon rounds onto baking paper and leave 30 minutes to set.
K: Cucumber, lime, mint and honey in sparkling water. H2O, not Gatorade.

Ice-cold sparkling water muddled with cucumber, lime and mint, lightly sweetened with honey syrup and served in tall glasses over crushed ice. Stir 3 tbsp honey into 3 tbsp hot water until dissolved and cool. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber into thin ribbons with a peeler. In a jug, muddle the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the honey syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice and cucumber ribbons. Add 1L chilled sparkling water to the jug, stir gently and pour over. Garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.

steps.text: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and cayenne. Whisk in the egg and buttermilk, then fold in the spring onions.
Rest the batter.
Stir together the mayonnaise, mustard, pickles, Cajun seasoning and lemon juice for the remoulade.
Heat the oil to 180C and drop in heaped teaspoons of batter. Fry, turning, until deep golden, working in batches.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with the remoulade.

steps.text: Cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins, score both sides and toss with the Cajun seasoning.
Sear the mushrooms in a very hot pan with the oil in a single layer, turning once, until well browned.
Drop the heat, add the butter and garlic and swirl until foaming.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with chopped parsley and serve from the pan with the baguette.

dishes.n: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo
dishes.make_ahead: Whole gumbo up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently; steam the rice and slice the spring onions fresh

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat until the roux turns dark brown like chocolate.
Add the onion, celery and capsicum and cook until soft.
Add the chicken, sausage, Cajun seasoning and stock. Simmer.
Add the okra and cook until tender. Meanwhile steam the rice.
Serve over rice with spring onion and hot sauce.

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat until the roux turns dark brown like chocolate.
Brown the mushrooms and vegetarian sausages in the extra oil in a frying pan.
Add the onion, celery and capsicum to the roux and cook until soft.
Add the mushrooms, sausages, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika and stock. Simmer.
Add the okra and cook until tender. Meanwhile steam the rice.
Serve over rice with spring onion and hot sauce.
